fp := faux.New(faux.Turn{
    Blocks: []core.ContentBlock{core.TextBlock{Text: "waiting"}},
    Delay:  500 * time.Millisecond,
})
agent, _ := agentkit.New(agentkit.Config{Provider: fp, Model: "claude-3-5-sonnet"})

go func() {
    _, _ = agent.Run(context.Background(), "run 1")
    close(gate)
}()

_, err := agent.Run(context.Background(), "run 2")
assert errors.Is(err, core.ErrBusy)
<-gate

tests.title: Assistant response with ToolUseBlock and StopReasonLength appends synthetic notice and continues
given: an assistant message with ToolUseBlock and StopReasonLength
tests.when: an assistant message with ToolUseBlock and StopReasonLength is processed
then: no tool handler functions in the batch are executed
each tool call receives the exact synthetic ToolResultMessage notice citing output token limit truncation
the synthetic results are appended to the transcript and the driver continues to the next turn without terminating
tests.pseudocode:
var handlerCalled bool
tool := core.Tool{
    Name: "my_tool",
    Handler: func(ctx context.Context, args json.RawMessage) (core.ToolResult, error) {
        handlerCalled = true
        return core.ToolResult{Content: "done"}, nil
    },
}
fp := faux.New(
    faux.FauxAssistantMessage(core.StopReasonLength, faux.FauxToolCall("call_1", "my_tool", `{"partial":`)),
    faux.FauxAssistantMessage(core.StopReasonStop, faux.FauxText("finished")),
)
agent, _ := agentkit.New(agentkit.Config{Provider: fp, Model: "claude-3-5-sonnet", Tools: []core.Tool{tool}})
res, err := agent.Run(context.Background(), "trigger")
assert err == nil
assert !handlerCalled

expectedNotice := "Tool call \"my_tool\" was not executed: the response hit the output token limit,\nso its arguments may be truncated. Re-issue the tool call with complete arguments."
tr := findToolResultInMessages(res.Messages, "call_1")
assert tr.Text == expectedNotice
assert res.Turns == 2

tests.title: Smoke: Run termination on budget limit exceeded before request dispatch
given: an Agent configured with MaxCostUSD and a faux provider whose first turn reports usage reaching MaxCostUSD
tests.when: accumulated cost meets or exceeds MaxCostUSD before issuing a model request
then: the driver halts before issuing the second request, returning RunStopBudgetExceeded and core.ErrBudgetExceeded
